== Summary ==
Identified: [[Tom Haid]] (left, black Japanese-text T-shirt), [[Barry Alperstein]] (center, plaid shirt), and [[Greg Shaw]] (right, Outrider Cup 2019 hoodie).
Top 8 players after the cut. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
